scientific_integrity: Previously published facet/vertex descriptions are credited; only the derived metric angle multiset, boundary acute-angle dichotomy, and uniform Gaussian ridge limit are asserted. Finite checks are supporting evidence rather than unrestricted proofs.
scientific_limitations: Standard Euclidean coordinate realization; uniformly counted ridges, not area-weighted; n at least 3 and positive integral parking parameters. The exact face-lattice and facet normal descriptions used in the proof are prior work. Independent audit and complete historical priority review have not been performed.
title: Universal dihedral-angle spectra and Gaussian ridge law for generalized parking-function polytopes
